note: INDEPENDENT ground truth (TESTING.md §6, review 2026-06-29). Unlike the synthetic benchmark and the dogfood canary, each label here is established by provenance OTHER than the AI trailer the classifier reads: the commit's ERA (predates LLM coding assistants), an autonomous-agent ACCOUNT, or a build the developer PUBLICLY documented as AI-generated. The star subset is `untrailered: true` — AI-authored commits that carry no trailer, the real-world blind spot the synthetic benchmark's recall hid. A trailer-only classifier MUST miss these; this corpus measures exactly that. Cases are a mix of cited-real public commits and representative-of-class commits; the label basis (never the trailer) is documented per case. The corpus grows via captured corrections (#69) and real labeled repos.
